main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.star record naming the repository in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, unless one is there already. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

description: Stars a repository as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
